Fixed. `JsonWriter.value(double)` in gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriter.java:500 now only rejects NaN/infinite values when not lenient, matching `value(Number)` behavior (its javadoc updated accordingly).

Validation:
- `JsonWriterTest`: 39/39 pass.
- Full `mvn -pl gson test`: the only failures (`ObjectTest#testDateAsMapObjectField`, date-adapter tests) are pre-existing and fail identically with my change stashed — they're locale/date-related and unrelated to this fix.
